exemption.reason: Docs and tenets only: the migration into default is a design (3h-M0) with nothing built, so no code path exists for a unit test to run and no user flow for an end-to-end test. The release changes docs/multi-workspace.md, docs/deployment.md, TENETS.md, CHANGELOG.md, the version fields and the CDK baseline's hashes (APP_VERSION). Its review is the reading of the design against the code it names (the key builders, the workspace delete's families, the members store) and against TENETS.md; M1 to M4 bring their own tests and the rehearsal.
